description:
Imports a public GitHub repository so it can be analyzed: indexes its source files
(.py .js .ts .jsx .tsx .rs .go .java) and its latest commits (up to 500) from the default
branch into a dependency and change-history graph. `repo_url` is
https://github.com/<owner>/<repository>; `branch` is accepted for compatibility. A repository
already imported is not imported again. Returns the project id and the number of commits and
files ingested.
name: hokmah_connect_project
title: Import Public GitHub Repository
